valid old explicit dark selection migrates and is not overridden by light OS settings
all four sampled font choices persist bounded actual preference scales and visible preview size

pure black night choice and manual theme selection change the resolved theme rather than empty controls
all theme colors share one picker and drive global colors with readable foregrounds
feed card columns stop at three and semi-transparent material keeps a readable tint

system night switching preserves the chosen palette and returns to its native header color in daylight
